name: Anime North
blurb: Canada's largest anime convention, a volunteer-run non-profit gathering in Toronto for anime, manga and Japanese pop culture.

editions.venue: Toronto Congress Centre / Delta Hotels Toronto Airport & Conference Centre
editions.evidence: Wikipedia infobox: 'Next event May 28, 2027'; corroborated by web search: 'Anime North 2027 takes place from May 28-30, 2027 at the Toronto Congress Centre and The Delta Toronto Airport Hotel.'

notes: animenorth.com returns a Cloudflare bot-check (HTTP 403) on every fetch method tried (headless Chromium, Edge channel, and WebFetch), so dates/venue come from Wikipedia's infobox plus a web search instead of the con's own pages. A second search turned up no 2027 guest announcements (only the already-past May 2026 lineup), so guests is 'none-yet'. Organizer name not confirmed from any reachable source.
